# Total Fog contributor instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the development workflow, performance policy
and compatibility requirements. Total Fog is maintained independently; use its
own namespaces and runtime types and preserve the attribution in NOTICE.md.

Optional integrations must retain native behavior without Total Fog. Confirmed
blockers in mods we cannot edit follow the upstream issue rule in AGENTS.md.
The integration contracts and a short example are in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
